description: Source code for trigger decoder in rusEfi firmware, including trigger state management, synchronization, RPM calculation, and trigger event decoding.

classes.name: TriggerState
classes.description: Manages trigger state, synchronization, and event decoding.

classes.name: TriggerStateWithRunningStatistics
classes.description: Extends TriggerState with RPM calculation and pre-synchronization timestamp handling.

classes.name: TriggerShape
classes.description: Represents trigger shape and synchronization points.

methods.name: resetTriggerState
methods.description: Resets trigger state variables to initial values.

methods.name: calculateTriggerSynchPoint
methods.description: Calculates synchronization point within trigger shape.

methods.name: getTotalEventCounter
methods.description: Returns total event count including current cycle.

methods.name: calculateInstantRpm
methods.description: Calculates RPM based on recent trigger events.

methods.name: setLastEventTimeForInstantRpm
methods.description: Records timestamp of last event before synchronization.

methods.name: runtimeStatistics
methods.description: Collects runtime statistics, overridden in derived class.

methods.name: isValidIndex
methods.description: Checks if current index is within trigger size.

methods.name: getStartOfRevolutionIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of start of current revolution.

methods.name: decodeTriggerEvent
methods.description: Processes a trigger event, updates state, and handles synchronization.

methods.name: handleTriggerError
methods.description: Handles trigger decoding errors and logs details.
